why: The cryscave's three 'touch the crystals in order' puzzle crystals lacked colour. Their material is [type 0x10 screen copy] [type 0x02 lit, MIX-blended, U-scrolled colour-band texture]; the port drew the first shader only (the lights' lavender on white vertices), so the three looked alike and pale. The fix: a material's shaders are drawn as passes, the screen-copy pass over the engine's frame copy (ps2e_draw_copy_frame). The judge: the crystals' bright pixels (HSV V >= 0.35 against the dark cave) in fixed boxes of fixed presents reach a mean saturation of 0.55 and a vivid share (S >= 0.6) of 0.35, and the pen's red one lies within 0.15 of the oracle's mean saturation when an oracle frame is given.
